messages:
Carlos (release-eng): pasted deploy-bot output below — starting canary v2.3.0 -> eu-west-1. running 5m postdeploy smoke (kv-prefix + embed route). will watch p95, error-rate, and synth probe entropy. please chime if you see anything.

deploy-bot: CANARY_START | service:inference | version:v2.3.0 | region:eu-west-1 | probes:synthetic(5m) kvcache(prefill) embed-route | id:cb-6187654321

Alice (eng-releases): seeing a small p95 blip already in the synth dashboard, ~1.2x baseline at 30s in. not huge but consistent across 3 probes :eyes:

Lena (platform-sre): yep — synth probe logs show higher entropy in outputs for the embed route, and a tiny uptick in tokenization time. hard to say if it's noise or model artifact. posting quick grep of probe errors: `grep "entropy" synth/* | wc -l` -> 14 in last 2m

Miguel (infra): infra metrics: no host OOMs, cpu stable. p95 CPU per pod +12%. KV prefill hit-rate dropped 0.6% (maybe cache warmup). sharing curl to reproduce locally: `curl -sS https://eu-west-1.synth.internal/v1/sample -d '{"route":"embed","prompt":"<test>"}'`

ops-bot: HEARTBEAT | eu-west-1 | synth-prefill | failures:3/60 | window:120s | severity:low

Alice (eng-releases): 3/60 is borderline but combined with p95 drift and entropy makes me uneasy. i'd prefer to hold the canary until we can replay failing prompts.

Carlos (release-eng): agree we should be cautious. proposal: extend canary hold by +15m, run targeted replay of the failed synth keys and compare top-k ngram overlap vs baseline. if probe failure rate >3% or p95 >1.5x baseline after extension -> pin to v2.2.9 and pause roll.

Lena (platform-sre): i'm starting replay now, grabbing the failing keys from synth store and running through local runner. will post a short diff when done.

Miguel (infra): FYI i can temporarily increase prefill concurrency to warm kvcache faster if we want to rule out cold-cache effects. command: `infra scale prefill --region eu-west-1 --concurrency 2x` — need ok from release team

Alice (eng-releases): go ahead Miguel, helps rule out infra-induced noise. also can we mute non-critical alerts to reduce noise?

Carlos (release-eng): Miguel proceed. Lena, hold me on the diff. i'll extend hold now.

deploy-bot: CANARY_HOLD_EXTEND | id:cb-6187654321 | hold_by:Carlos | extra:15m | reason:postdeploy-synth-variance

Lena (platform-sre): replay results (summary): 120 failed keys -> generated responses have lower top-1 overlap with baseline (median overlap down ~18%). attaching snippet of two failing examples: `"baseline": "user asked for list of steps...", "candidate": "list omitted extra context..."` — suggests model behavior shift not infra-only

Alice (eng-releases): that's concerning — behavior shift consistent across prompts. i'd vote pin to v2.2.9 if we don't see recovery in next 10m.

Carlos (release-eng): agreed. policy: if behavior regression confirmed (>=10% of probe set with quality delta) -> pin. we still have 10m on the hold, monitoring now.

ops-bot: ALERT | synth-quality-regression | delta:median -18% | affected:120/1000 probes | autocheck:manual_review_required

Miguel (infra): prefill concurrency increased, cache hit-rate improving. infra metrics look stable.

Alice (eng-releases): thanks miguel. still leaning pin, but if model calms in 10m we'll let canary continue and escalate to hotfix team if not. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Carlos (release-eng): decision: extend hold to full 15m (already extended), do not rollback yet. if at end of hold synth failures persist (>3% failure or quality delta >=10%) then we'll pin to v2.2.9 and notify product. If it recovers, we continue rollout and close thread. I'll update status at hold expiry.

deploy-bot: ACK | hold extended until +15m | monitor window started

Alice (eng-releases): :thumbsup:

Lena (platform-sre): continuing replay and targeted tests, will post any notable diffs.

Carlos (release-eng): noted. thanks team — staying glued to dashboards. will call pin/rollback if thresholds hit.
